rows.coordinator_observation: Reads one int from RegistryFriendlyByteBuf into InfectionStatus for LivingEntity and otherwise returns previousValue. This is live network attachment sync for infection ticks, not persistent old-world or permanent progress restoration.
rows.application_limit: No research credit toward migration gate.

rows.coordinator_observation: Player attachment serializer checks holder instanceof Player, binds a new WerewolfPlayer to that actual player then delegates deserializeNBT; wrong holder throws. Owner-binding observation relevant but wrapper must be merged with full deserialize chain.
rows.application_limit: No standalone credit; primary agent may already study full chain.

rows.coordinator_observation: Native entity readAdditionalSaveData loads ColorFlags default0 and Rewarded defaultfalse, then home point; server aiStep checks color count>15 AND !Rewarded before reward, then sets Rewarded. Preserving only color progress without its reward receipt would replay completed rewards; preserve pairs and do not invoke reward during migration.
rows.application_limit: Modern ValueInput API differs from Forge1.20.1 CompoundTag; principles only, not direct code copy.

rows.coordinator_observation: IStorage.readNBT reads maxMana/maxBurnout first, then current values, then optional blood type. Paired writer stores exactly the same doubles and optional type. Restoring bounds before bounded current state is meaningful. Unconditional double getters give missing keys0 and unchecked CompoundTag cast, so Dynasty should copy only present typed approved fields instead of forcing defaults over existing progress.
rows.application_limit: Older Capability.IStorage API; mana and burnout include transient state and are not automatic Dynasty permanent whitelist candidates.

rows.coordinator_observation: MiscCapabilityStorage writer emits fairy_selected UUID only if nonnull. Reader uses hasUniqueId before helper read, else explicitly clears selected fairy. Type/existence guard and correct nullable clearing avoid stale owner reference; distinguish absent optional selection from durable earned progress.
rows.application_limit: Selection is a reference preference, not proof a given Dynasty owner UUID should survive death. No death handler demonstrated in this method.
